evidence.description: The recovered source article describes DQCS spectral responses to Cd(II), Co(II) and Ni(II) and molecular electronic calculations. The task bounds the investigation to the molecular electronic/optical account and its relationship to those observations. Source facts/author interpretation are distinguished in the source_scope_audit.

How does association with Cd(II), Co(II) or Ni(II) affect the molecular electronic and optical behavior of DQCS, and what explanation is supported? Determine what the chosen molecular models can establish about the supplied spectral observations and what remains unassigned. Identify physical states and observables rather than equating root numbers or frontier gaps. Validate the submitted model and electronic description to the extent required by its claims, including relevant spin and medium assumptions. Electronic hardness/softness derived from the same orbital gap are algebraically related, not independent confirmation of a mechanism.
